attempt_budget: Proposes exactly one additional payload attempt per listed object in a separate appended recovery lineage. This explicitly extends an exhausted budget and reclassifies specified worker BrokenPipe exceptions; it is not an automatic retry grant. Old attempts and terminal labels remain immutable.
eligibility_gate: Root freeze/release of this exact object subset and one-attempt extension after review.
Original process must be terminal and the existing original queue.lock acquired exclusively before recovery; never stop, signal or bypass the live queue.
Bind the original run terminal completion and exclude every original-run success; never redownload a verified object.
Recheck all bound history digests, no orphan intent, and each partial type/stat tuple; changed candidates stop for reconciliation.

Refresh exact versioned-source HEAD using verified TLS, no redirects, required ETag/version/total length before opening a payload GET; failed metadata check consumes no payload attempt and starts no requests for that object.

Keep separate recovery journal and preserve original files/history. Resume retained partial at exact offset with If-Match, strict206/range/length/version, source size/MD5 and required Git-blob SHA1 before atomic publication; then local SHA256.
Check all still-declared unwritten bytes plus100GiB reserve and64GiB output allowance. One worker only; do not relabel patients or admit payloads.
limitations: Original records contain exception type/message, not traceback. Main progress logger runs outside the per-object handler; stored worker BrokenPipe results cannot have been produced by that logger. Exact original socket/read/write stack location is unknown. Supplied transport-stage response evidence and short regular partials support a narrow candidate reclassification, not a claim that every original operation is known.
remaining_queue_independence: This proposal does not alter or pause the active iterator. Recovery is queued behind the existing exclusive queue lock; no concurrent request for any listed object is permitted.
required_adapter_delta: Journal generic opener failures with error type and phase without inventing HTTP status.

Record traceback and phase (open/read/write/verify/journal/log). BrokenPipe in HTTP open/read may be transport; logger BrokenPipe must disable optional console output without creating an object failure. Ordinary filesystem or checksum/source-identity failures remain nonretryable.
Use reviewed separate recovery scope/history extension rather than altering the old attempt counters or original runner.
Check-only refuses while original process/queue remains live. No live-source change.
